chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام used to go out in the midday heat for a task that had already been taken care of, wanting Allah, the Exalted, to see him tiring himself in seeking the halal.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام demonstrate the virtue of striving for halal livelihood?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the conduct of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام in exerting himself personally in the pursuit of halal livelihood. It highlights the ethical value of effort, dignity in work, and seeking Allah’s pleasure through lawful earning.
